## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Resuming an interrupted Atomic-backed phase continues the engine run with...

The system SHALL ensure that resuming an interrupted Atomic-backed phase continues the engine run with the same runId instead of starting a new attempt.

#### Scenario: Resuming an interrupted Atomic-backed phase continues the engine run with...

WHEN `promote-atomic-executor-to-opt-in-implement-and-validate` is implemented
THEN Resuming an interrupted Atomic-backed phase continues the engine run with the same runId instead of starting a new attempt.

### Requirement: A recorded-fixture test shows an interrupted run does not repeat a tool...

The system SHALL ensure that a recorded-fixture test shows an interrupted run does not repeat a tool marked non-replayable.

#### Scenario: A recorded-fixture test shows an interrupted run does not repeat a tool...

WHEN `promote-atomic-executor-to-opt-in-implement-and-validate` is implemented
THEN A recorded-fixture test shows an interrupted run does not repeat a tool marked non-replayable.

### Requirement: An Atomic-backed phase produces the same metaharness-visible artifacts...

The system SHALL ensure that an Atomic-backed phase produces the same metaharness-visible artifacts (phase-progress journal, effects journal, PhaseRecord) as an opaque vendor CLI phase.

#### Scenario: An Atomic-backed phase produces the same metaharness-visible artifacts...

WHEN `promote-atomic-executor-to-opt-in-implement-and-validate` is implemented
THEN An Atomic-backed phase produces the same metaharness-visible artifacts (phase-progress journal, effects journal, PhaseRecord) as an opaque vendor CLI phase.

### Requirement: Executor selection is opt-in per phase and per change; with it disabled,...

The system SHALL ensure that executor selection is opt-in per phase and per change; with it disabled, behavior is identical to today's.

#### Scenario: Executor selection is opt-in per phase and per change; with it disabled,...

WHEN `promote-atomic-executor-to-opt-in-implement-and-validate` is implemented
THEN Executor selection is opt-in per phase and per change; with it disabled, behavior is identical to today's.
